legend-trail-of-the-ancients.story: National Scenic Byway. archaeology, desert, mesa landscapes. A one-way ride of 207 km, Cortez to the finish - roughly 3 h 46 in the saddle. On the way it passes Trail of the Ancients and Blanding. The highest point is about 2,450 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Trail of the Ancients
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is Trail of the Ancients, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
